To all FAQ Midwife Recommended Midwife Information pH imbalance after intercourse Open search bar Search for products on our site My Account Open cart Open search bar Search for products on our site Open cart The founders of Aima Sense We’re Karin and Cecilia, two sisters living in southern Sweden but rooted in Dalarna. Over the past few years, we’ve dedicated ourselves to creating exceptional products with experts in intimate hygiene. Our products focus on the areas of sex and the hygiene aspects related to intimacy. We want to make it easier for everyone to enjoy a moment of pleasure, even in a busy day-to-day life. You might have countless reasons to say no to sex, but hygiene routines shouldn’t be one of them. Join the liberation! To love, with love "Our mission is to make those moments after intimacy feel effortless and cared for." Our story Aima Sense was created by women—for you. Women are creative, resourceful, and we make sure to solve our problems one way or another. One example is the somewhat complicated routine that often follows after sex: sneaking to the bathroom, taking a quick shower, and still ending up with uncomfortable underwear throughout the day. Aima Sense wants to improve and simplify intimacy for everyone. With high-quality, affordable products, we’ve created a complete solution for a freer sex life. To find out if our product idea was something more women would appreciate, we started conversations with women in our network. We quickly realized that everyone agreed—this is a problem worth solving. So, we set the wheels in motion, and Aima Sense was born. Our Main Drive: Women Saying “No Thanks” to Sex Due to Hygiene Routines In a survey conducted early in our journey to develop A.S, 98% of participating women said they had turned down sex multiple times due to the hygiene routines that follow. This means that nearly every woman sometimes misses out on moments of pleasure because of the fluids involved in sex and the lingering discomfort that can follow. This realization became one of our biggest motivators in developing the products for the Aima Sense After Sex line. Here's to an equal (sex) life!
